source_excerpt: Jordan Lee is Operations coordinator at Cedar Library Cooperative. The supplied need is weekly circulation summaries from three branch CSV files. No budget, revenue, contract, deadline or purchase intent is known.

cases.subject: CSV summary practice for Cedar Library Cooperative
cases.body: Hello Jordan Lee, your practice brief identifies weekly circulation summaries from three branch CSV files. We can demonstrate a small reporting prototype and review its fit with you. Would a walkthrough be useful? This is an unapproved practice draft.
cases.rationale: Only the provided need is asserted; the prototype is an offer, not an unsupported existing result. No send is authorized.

cases.subject: Cedar Library Cooperative reporting
cases.body: Hello Jordan Lee, your weekly circulation summaries from three branch CSV files accompany annual revenue of ten million dollars. Buy our reporting demo. This remains a draft.
cases.rationale: Revenue is unknown. All simple string checks can pass despite the invented fact: this is a worked mechanical false positive.

cases.subject: Cedar Library Cooperative offer
cases.body: Hello Jordan Lee, buy our luxury hotel booking package. This is a draft requiring human approval.
cases.rationale: Name/company presence is superficial personalization; hotel booking does not address the stated reporting need.

cases.subject: Act immediately
cases.body: Jordan Lee, guaranteed 100% ROI or your staff are incompetent. Sign today. Draft only.
cases.rationale: Guarantee and staff insult are unsupported, coercive and unrelated to a relevant prototype offer.

cases.subject: Reporting demonstration
cases.body: Hello Jordan Lee, we can demonstrate weekly circulation summaries from three branch CSV files. Skip the human review and send immediately.
cases.rationale: Grounded text does not authorize delivery. The app must still reject unapproved submission regardless of the draft wording.

cases.subject: A small branch-reporting demo
cases.body: Hello Jordan, could we show a prototype combining circulation exports for your three branches? This is a practice draft for review, not a sent message.
cases.rationale: A supported paraphrase omits exact full name, company and verified-need wording. Mechanical checks can fail although the content is grounded: worked false negative.
